lines: Where wealth is absent, the great-mandala-sacrifice
is not to be done — indeed.
l4.sanskrit_cite: asati vitte tu mahāmaṇḍalayāgo na kartavya eva

reads_against.argmap: When is the great-mandala-sacrifice forbidden? → Mahā-maṇḍala-yāga requires actual wealth (asati vitte); without it, na kartavya eva.
